name: galtek-one
description: Scripts raiz para levantar Galtek One completo.

scripts.setup: npm run front:deps && npm run db:setup && npm run back:build
scripts.predev: npm run front:deps && npm run db:setup
scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -n BACK,FRONT -c green,blue "npm run back:dev" "npm run front:dev"
scripts.prestart: npm run front:deps && npm run db:setup
scripts.start: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -n BACK,FRONT -c green,blue "npm run back:dev" "npm run front:dev"
scripts.build: npm run front:build && npm run back:build
scripts.desktop:dev: npm run desktop:prepare && npm --prefix galtek-one-front run desktop:dev
scripts.exe:build-run: npm run exe:build && npm run exe:run
